newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: VENDEX SEES HIGHER OPERATING PROFITS.
newsitem.headline: VENDEX SEES HIGHER OPERATING PROFITS.

text.p: Retail and business services group Vendex International NV said on Tuesday it expected higher operating profits in its three main areas of business in 1996/97 as long as consumer spending held up at second quarter levels.

"If the growth of consumer spending which occurred in the second quarter of the year continues, and subject to unforeseen circumstances, we expect for the fiscal year 1996/97 as a whole that, in addition to the already envisaged increase in the food and services sectors, operating income will also show an increase in the non-food retail trade," Vendex said.

Vendex said the relatively high rate of growth of operating profit in the first half of 1996/97 could not be taken as a reliable indicator for the year as a whole. Interest charges would not show a further fall in the second half of the year, but would remain at the previous year's level, it added.

Vendex said it could not yet make a forecast of full-year 1996/97 net profit as it did not have enough insight into the contribution from changes in the value of fixed assets and securities nor from its unconsolidated holdings.
Earlier Vendex said first-half 1996/97 operating profit rose to 153 million guilders from 129 million in the same period of 1995/96 while net profit rose to 151 million from 125 million.
